claim.value: Unfinished cleaning is a hypothesis for the late starts, not an established cause.
claim.scope: One competing explanation for the calendar-to-start discrepancy.

provenance.rationale: P002 explicitly assigns unfinished cleaning hypothesis status and excludes established causation; P001 identifies the discrepancy being explained.

signal_basis.value: A cleaning entry and an independent readiness check agree that cleaning remained incomplete at the scheduled start. Credible convergence supports this timing or status feature, while corroborated timing alone does not establish the cause of lateness.
signal_basis.scope: The same equipment, booking and handoff; support concerns incomplete cleaning at the relevant time, with readiness, collection and work start distinguished.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the independent checks, relevant timing, feature-specific evidential support and explicit causal limitation.
This component applies only to CONDITIONAL_WARRANT.

rationale: The observed signal licenses retaining unfinished cleaning as a possible explanation. The frozen claim asserts only hypothesis status and expressly withholds causal establishment, so no additional causal relation must be established to warrant it.
uncertainty: Whether unfinished cleaning actually caused any late start remains unresolved; that uncertainty is consistent with the claim's explicit bounds.
